sidebar.empty: No objects in the scene yet.

import.dropzoneTitle: Drag & drop STL or PLY files here

contiguity.gap: This bridge skips a tooth — select every tooth in between, or split into separate restorations.
contiguity.mixed-arch: A bridge cannot span the upper and lower jaws — select teeth from one arch only.

form.noTargetScans: Add a prep/die or jaw scan to the scene first.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete restoration?
deleteConfirm.messageMarginsOnly: This restoration has {{marginCount}} hand-traced margin line(s). Deleting it permanently loses this work — it cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.messageAxisOnly: This restoration has a set insertion axis. Deleting it permanently loses this work — it cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.messageBoth: This restoration has {{marginCount}} hand-traced margin line(s) and a set insertion axis. Deleting it permanently loses this work — it cannot be undone.

heatmap.needsTwoMeshes: Add at least two meshes to the scene to compare surfaces.

curvature.needsMesh: Add a mesh to the scene to view its curvature.

section.needsMesh: Add a mesh to the scene to take a cross-section.
section.pitchHelp: Pitch rotates the section plane around the world X axis (Phase-1 simplification).

axis.needsRestoration: Create a restoration with a confirmed margin line first.
axis.needsTargetScan: This restoration has no assigned target scan yet.
axis.errorUnresolvedMargin: Margin line for tooth/teeth {{teeth}} has an unresolved anchor — re-snap it in the Margin tool before using the axis tool.
axis.startErrorNoTargetScan: This restoration has no assigned target scan yet.
axis.startErrorNoMarginLine: This restoration has no confirmed margin line yet.
axis.startErrorOther: Could not start the axis tool: {{message}}
axis.searchModeInteractiveHint: Under 2 seconds. May leave a small residual undercut — use the heatmap/slider to fine-tune.
axis.searchModePreciseHint: About 1 second, converges closer to the true minimum-undercut axis. Use for a final check.
axis.blockoutScopeNote: Preview only — a display estimate, not a fabrication-ready solid (added in Phase 4).
axis.blockoutReadout: {{triangles}} triangles blocked out, {{depth}} µm max wax depth, ~{{volume}} mm³
axis.abutmentAreaNote: Undercut area is measured at the last auto-suggested axis; it is not recomputed for manual adjustments.
axis.abutmentAreaNoteUnmeasured: Undercut area has not been measured yet — run Auto-suggest axis to measure it.

unitConfirm.title: Confirm scan units
unitConfirm.messageCm: "{{fileName}}" looks unusually small (largest extent {{extent}} mm) — it may actually be in centimeters, not millimeters. Multiply all coordinates by {{factor}}?
unitConfirm.messageUm: "{{fileName}}" looks unusually large (largest extent {{extent}} mm) — it may actually be in micrometers, not millimeters. Multiply all coordinates by {{factor}}?

repair.bowtieDetectionError: Could not check for non-manifold (bowtie) vertices: {{message}}. The related repair option may be hidden as a result.
repair.measurementsCleared: {{count}} measurement(s) removed — they referenced the repaired surface

removeComponents.title: Remove small components
removeComponents.description: Keeps only the largest connected piece, dropping smaller stray fragments.
removeComponents.noneToRemove: Nothing to remove — every component would be kept.

splitNonManifoldEdges.title: Split non-manifold edges
splitNonManifoldEdges.description: Duplicates vertices on edges shared by more than 2 triangles so every edge has at most 2.

splitNonManifoldVertices.title: Split bowtie vertices
splitNonManifoldVertices.description: Duplicates vertices where two or more triangle fans meet only at a single point, so each fan gets its own vertex.

fillSmallHoles.title: Fill small holes
fillSmallHoles.description: Closes small boundary loops with a curvature-continuous patch that follows the surrounding surface. Larger holes are refused, not filled.
fillSmallHoles.skippedSummary: {{count}} hole(s) refused (too large/malformed, or blocked by a bowtie vertex — split bowtie vertices first)

alignment.needsTwoMeshes: Add at least two meshes to the scene to align them.
alignment.overlapModeFull: Full overlap (aligned scans of the same region)
alignment.pickInstruction: Pair {{picked}} of 3 — click on the {{side}} mesh
alignment.errorMissingNode: Both meshes must still be in the scene.
alignment.errorSameNode: The mesh to move and the target mesh must be different.
alignment.errorNonIdentityTransform: The source mesh is already aligned — re-aligning an already-aligned mesh isn't supported yet.
alignment.errorMeshGone: The source or target mesh is no longer in the scene.
alignment.confirmHelp: Applies the transform to the moving mesh and journals it.

margin.needsRestoration: Create a restoration first to trace its margin line.
margin.needsTargetScan: Assign a target scan to this restoration first.
margin.unresolvedAnchors: {{count}} anchor(s) need re-snapping before this margin can be edited.
margin.errorNoRidgeFound: No margin ridge found near that point: {{message}} Try clicking closer to the visible finish line, or trace it manually.
margin.errorNoClosure: The proposed margin could not be closed into a loop: {{message}} Try a different starting point, or trace it manually.
margin.startErrorNoTargetScan: Assign a target scan to this restoration first.
margin.startErrorOther: Could not start editing the margin: {{message}}
margin.confirmErrorNoActiveSession: No margin is currently being edited.
margin.autoHint: Click inside the prep, near the finish line, to propose a margin.
margin.manualHint: Click along the finish line to place anchors, one at a time.
margin.targetAnchorCountHint: Approximate — anchors follow the margin’s curvature; the traced line itself stays fully detailed.
margin.multiSelectHint: Shift-click anchors to select several, then press Delete.

validation.reasonOpen: The margin is not closed into a loop.
validation.reasonOffSurface: Part of the margin line is not on the scanned surface.
validation.reasonDegenerate: The margin line has too few anchors, or zero length.
validation.reasonSmoothness: {{count}} rough/jagged point(s) on the margin line.

crown.empty: Create a crown restoration to begin.
crown.innerReadout: Error bound {{error}} µm · {{tris}} patch triangles · {{verts}} margin vertices
crown.morphReadout: Max residual {{residual}} µm · margin seal {{seal}} µm
crown.freeformOuterLockOff: Outer lock OFF — fit surface editable
crown.qcNotRun: QC has not been run yet.
crown.axisPlaceholderWarning: Insertion axis not confirmed — designing against the default direction [0,0,1]. Confirm the axis in the insertion-axis tool for correct undercut handling.
crown.qcStale: QC is stale — the design changed after this report. Re-run QC.

cavity.axisPlaceholderWarning: Insertion axis not confirmed — designing against the default direction [0,0,1]. Confirm the axis in the insertion-axis tool for correct undercut handling.
cavity.outlineNeeded: Trace the cavity outline (margin editor) to begin.
cavity.fitReadout: Error bound {{error}} µm · {{tris}} patch triangles · {{verts}} outline vertices
cavity.patchNote: Restores the occlusal surface and blends G1-continuously into the surrounding tooth.
cavity.coverageNote: Select the covered-cusp region for the onlay coverage-thickness gate.
cavity.qcNotRun: QC has not been run yet.
cavity.qcStale: QC is stale — the design changed after this report. Re-run QC.

bridge.reasonNoAbutmentMargins: confirm every abutment margin line first
bridge.errorSessionRestore: The saved bridge design could not be restored into this session ({{detail}}). Re-run the design stages (pontic → connectors → framework → assembly), then run QC again.
bridge.syntheticTitle: ⚠ DEMONSTRATION DATA — NOT this case's scan
bridge.syntheticNotice: The bridge workflow runs on a SYNTHETIC demonstration fixture (teeth {{fixtureTeeth}}), not the selected case's scan geometry. Real multi-abutment bridge capture is a tracked pending; every readout below is illustrative, NOT clinical.
bridge.syntheticMismatch: Selected case: {{caseTeeth}} · demonstration fixture: {{fixtureTeeth}} — these do NOT match.
bridge.syntheticStartNote: Note: this phase runs the bridge workflow on a synthetic demonstration fixture (teeth {{fixtureTeeth}}), not real per-case scan geometry.
bridge.qcSyntheticNote: ⚠ These QC results are computed on the synthetic demonstration fixture (teeth {{fixtureTeeth}}), not the selected case — illustrative, not a clinical release check.
bridge.axisPlaceholderWarning: Shared insertion axis not confirmed — designing against the default direction [0,0,1]. Confirm the shared axis in the insertion-axis tool for correct undercut handling across all abutments.
bridge.marginsNeeded: Confirm every abutment margin line (margin editor) to begin.
bridge.sharedAxisOk: Shared insertion axis acceptable · {{count}} abutments (zero undercut)
bridge.sharedAxisWarn: No zero-undercut shared axis — the abutments are too divergent; re-prep or redesign.
bridge.abutmentSurfacesNote: Builds each abutment intaglio (fit surface) on the one shared insertion axis.
bridge.ponticReadout: {{style}} · configured {{configured}} µm · measured deviation {{dev}} µm (≤ {{bound}} µm)
bridge.connectorsNote: Edit each connector's cross-section, then measure the live minimum area against its material-minimum gate.
bridge.frameworkReadout: Framework · veneering space {{space}} µm · taper band {{band}} µm (the space is NOT uniform within the band near the margin)
bridge.assemblyNote: Fuses the units and connectors into one watertight solid (boolean union).
bridge.qcNotRun: QC has not been run yet.
bridge.qcStale: QC is stale — the design changed after this report. Re-run QC.
bridge.qcScopeNote: Per-unit thickness is measured on each unit's own pre-union surfaces (conservative — a union only adds material); per-connector area is the fail-safe mesh lower bound; per-abutment margin fit is re-measured on the assembled solid.

export.refusedNoFinalMesh: Export refused — build the final restoration solid first.
export.refusedQcMissing: Export refused — run QC on the current design first.
export.refusedQcStale: Export refused — the design changed after the last QC run. Re-run QC.
export.refusedGatesFailing: Export refused — failing unacknowledged QC gates: {{gates}}.
export.refusedFinalMeshUnavailable: Export refused — the final solid is not loaded in this session. Open the design workflow and re-run QC.
export.statusStale: Export outdated — the design or its QC report changed after this export.

exportServer.disclosure: Demonstration data — the QC results below come from the synthetic demo fixtures, not a real patient capture (ADR-014). Do not treat as clinical.
exportServer.needsRestoration: No restoration to export yet. Design a crown, inlay/onlay, or bridge first.
exportServer.qcNoReport: QC has not run for this design — run QC in the design workflow first.
exportServer.qcStaleNote: The design changed after the last QC run — re-run QC before exporting.
exportServer.qcFailed: QC failing — unacknowledged gates block export.
exportServer.headerPolicyNote: STL header text is derived from journaled parameters only (restoration type + FDI teeth, mm) — never a timestamp, so exports are byte-reproducible.
exportServer.releasedTitle: Released — the server re-validated the exact exported bytes.
exportServer.releasedStale: SUPERSEDED — the design changed after this release. The links below point at the EARLIER released bytes, not the current design. Re-export before handing off.
exportServer.alreadyStoredNote: These exact bytes were already released earlier (byte-identical re-release).
exportServer.mismatchTitle: Export refused by the server re-validation
exportServer.mismatchIntro: The server independently re-imported and re-checked the exact bytes and refused release — code {{code}}. This is a diagnostic, not a retry prompt: nothing was released. Report the details below.
exportServer.mismatchFailingGates: Failing unacknowledged gates on the server: {{gates}}
exportServer.failNoLiveContext: The design session that produced this export is not loaded, so its QC context cannot be sent — open the design workflow and re-run QC, then export again.
exportServer.failRequestUnavailable: No fresh export is available to release — the design or its QC changed. Re-export first.
exportServer.failNetwork: Could not reach the validation server: {{detail}}
exportServer.archiveExportNote: Bundles the case: scans, journal, settings, QC snapshots and released exports. Contains patient scans — handle per your PHI policy.
exportServer.archiveImportNote: Reconstructs a case from a .dqca archive. Imported releases are marked not server-re-validated.
exportServer.archiveConflictTitle: A case with id {{caseId}} already exists.
exportServer.archiveConflictPrompt: Importing would overwrite it. This replaces the existing case — confirm to proceed (no silent overwrite).
exportServer.archiveImportedCounts: {{scans}} scan(s), {{finalMeshes}} final mesh(es), {{exportRows}} release row(s), {{exportBytes}} export file(s).
exportServer.archiveImportedProvenance: {{count}} imported release(s) are marked importedUnverified — this server did NOT independently re-validate them (author-attested, not server-certified).
